title: Immersive Vehicles (MTS/IV) - Official Content Pack - [OCP] - Planes, Cars, Helicopters & More!
summary: Official Content Pack with  planes, cars, tanks, helicopters and trucks for the Immersive Vehicles mod!
description:
This is the Official Content Pack for Immersive Vehicles.

Coremod "Immersive Vehicles" is required in order for this pack to work!  (Curse Link)

OCP is also available on Modrinth!
(just in case Forge goes down)

OCP contains state of the art planes, cars, tanks, helicopters and trucks that are functionally kept simple
to not only show off what is possible with the Immersive Vehicles mod from a technical standpoint,
but also provide a carefully contructed immersive and user-friendly flying and driving experience.
All vehicles and parts are craftable in survival.
